title.narrative: TEAM RESPEKT (Reproductive and Sexual Program for Kenyan Teenagers)

description.narrative: With an aim of making sure the impact of the MSAKE /IMCC project is sustainable, Team RESPEKT focuses on working with high school students and teachers in creating a self reliant high school club that can be a safe space for sharing SRHR information. The project will engage in generation of scientific research data that can be used to lobby policy makers to make more SRHR friendly policies as well as build a movement of SRHR youth advocates in 10 universities. The project applies a rights-based approach in combating the harmful cultural practices that have limited access to SRHR information and services for teenagers. At the end of the partnership project, the project-results are to be presented at Regional Summits in Kenya where all volunteers and other relevant stakeholders may be invited with the purpose of raising awareness on SRHR issues.
